description: Defines when to BLOCK for human approval vs auto-proceed with file output
checkpoint_model: Hybrid: Most gates auto-proceed with audit trail, critical decisions require approval

auto_proceed_checkpoints.description: These checkpoints auto-proceed and write to files for later review

checkpoints.rationale: Pre-mortem analysis is preparatory and low-risk
checkpoints.validation: Verify file contains all 4 failure modes documented

checkpoints.rationale: Structured gate with clear template, can be reviewed later
checkpoints.validation: Verify probability update calculated and sufficiency check completed
Verify observable implications tested (≥3/6 for leading hypothesis)
Verify evidence pattern assessed and trajectory determined

checkpoints.rationale: If adversarial strengthened, weakened, or unchanged classification, proceed
checkpoints.validation: Verify verdict documented with confidence adjustment

checkpoints.rationale: Calculations are deterministic given evidence and LR tables
checkpoints.validation: Verify posterior calculation formula applied correctly

block_checkpoints.description: These checkpoints BLOCK execution and require human approval to proceed

checkpoints.rationale: Tier 1/2 contradictions require human judgment to resolve
checkpoints.prompt_user: Unresolved contradiction detected between high-quality evidence sources. Please review and decide resolution path.
options: Accept Evidence A and discount Evidence B
Accept Evidence B and discount Evidence A
Weight both equally and document uncertainty

checkpoints.rationale: Classification reversal from adversarial is significant and requires review
checkpoints.prompt_user: Adversarial challenge resulted in classification change. Original: {original_classification}. Revised: {revised_classification}. Please review adversarial reasoning and approve/modify.

checkpoints.rationale: Final classification is the key deliverable and must be approved
checkpoints.prompt_user: Bank: {bank_name}. Classification: {classification} ({variant}). Confidence: {confidence}%. Please review full reasoning chain and approve.

checkpoints.rationale: Low confidence classifications should not proceed without review
checkpoints.prompt_user: Classification confidence is {confidence}% (below 50% threshold). Classification: {classification}. Key uncertainties: {uncertainties}. Please decide action.
options: Accept low confidence and flag for validation

checkpoints.rationale: Consistency failures indicate systematic issues requiring review
checkpoints.prompt_user: Cross-bank consistency test failed: {test_name}. Banks affected: {bank_list}. Issue: {issue_description}. Please review.

checkpoints.rationale: Anchor points are immutable facts; violations indicate error
checkpoints.prompt_user: Classification violates anchor point: {anchor_point}. Bank: {bank_name}. Classification: {classification}. This requires immediate review.

checkpoints.rationale: Extreme LRs may indicate double-counting or error
checkpoints.prompt_user: Extreme combined LR detected: {combined_lr}. Bank: {bank_name}. Evidence count: {evidence_count}. Please review for double-counting.
options: Accept extreme LR (evidence is genuinely strong)

validation_checks.description: Automated validation checks performed by orchestrator before advancing stages

checks.trigger: Before advancing past any reasoning gate
checks.validation: Verify gate output file exists and contains all required sections
checks.action_on_failure: BLOCK and alert: Gate incomplete, cannot proceed

checks.action_on_warning: Flag for review: Low evidence count may indicate insufficient search

checks.validation: Verify null-results.md file exists and is not empty
checks.action_on_warning: Flag for review: No null results documented suggests incomplete search

checks.validation: Verify ≥3 of 6 implications tested for leading hypothesis

checks.action_on_failure: BLOCK: Adversarial protocol incomplete for tier

rules.rule_name: Skip to Adversarial if High Confidence Early
rules.condition: P(Architect) > 80% OR P(Pragmatist) > 80% after Gate 1 or Gate 2
rules.action: Skip remaining evidence tiers and proceed directly to Adversarial Challenge
rules.rationale: High confidence early suggests additional evidence gathering has diminishing returns

rules.action: Flag for potential extended Tier 3 search or targeted disconfirming searches
rules.rationale: Substantial uncertainty benefits from additional evidence

rules.rule_name: Confidence Cap Based on Evidence Tier
rules.action: Apply confidence cap based on highest tier evidence found
rules.rationale: Confidence cannot exceed quality of available evidence

logging_requirements.description: What must be logged in checkpoint-log.json
